newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Trading calm despite earnings rush.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Trading calm despite earnings rush.

text.p: After-hours activity was quiet on Thursday, traders said, despite a deluge of earnings announcements.
"It's not busy right now," a trader said.
The New York Stock Exchange said its session one volume was 22,300 shares compared to 3,100 shares on Wednesday. Session two volume was 3,913,400 shares compared to 2,527,200 shares on Wednesday.
The American Stock Exchange said there was no after-hours activity.
